'''Heltiss''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who ran the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. Heltiss was considered to be one of the finest physicians from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].
